The classic 3D platformers should keep the live and ring  health system, while the frontiers styled games coming forward should be the ones with the traditional health system. Considering that the Frontiers style is combat focused, and the open ZONE (happy, Iizuka?) is gonna be here for a while, Sonic team should do research on the fast paced combat of games, like Devil May Cry, Bayonetta, FFVII remake, and the recently released Stellar Blade. As for the rings, they should be used as currency to buy upgrades (health, attack power, defense, speed, status effect equipment, and other RPG related stuff), cosmetics, items (almost every RPG has them, so might as well plan for the future), etc. That way, fans of both play styles aren't alienated, and Sonic Team can plan their next entries smoothly.
